information: **Português:** - É imprescíndivel ter lido o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) antes desta competição; - A premiação acontecerá no [Campeonato Mineiro 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026); - Havendo qualquer dúvida, favor contactar algum dos organizadores ou Delegados listados. --- **English:** - It is mandatory that you have read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before this competition; - The awards will take place at the [Campeonato Mineiro 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026); - If you have any questions, please contact one of the listed organizers or Delegates.
